purpose: Offline request-body capture only. No provider calls, academic evidence, case authorship, benchmark result, registration mutation, or contract/prompt change.
reason: The frozen helper throws after its malformed base response. Inherited evaluation stores its cache only after a parseable retry, so the throw prevents offline preflight from capturing the actual completion retry. R2 returns a schema-shaped synthetic sizing-only retry to warm a process-local cache, while retaining both full request bodies, keys, and output caps in the preflight; synthetic responses are not exported as academic evidence.
